_note: frame: the view on selecting a clip covers what was placed, margin times its size, between min and max metres tall. pickMargin: pixels around a thing that still grab it. manualOffset: metres in front of the view centre where a person or object added by hand appears. speed: [min, max, step] of the playback speed. panelWidth, fontSize: the list panel (pixels). verticalKey: hold it while dragging to move up and down instead of over the ground.
